[{"sentence": 118, "text": "The Storage component performs CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on data entities individually."}, {"sentence": 119, "text": "It contains minimal logic beyond what is directly relevant to CRUD operations."}, {"sentence": 120, "text": "In particular, it is reponsible for the following."}, {"sentence": 121, "text": "Validating data inside entities before creating/updating them, to ensure they are in a valid state."}, {"sentence": 122, "text": "Hiding the complexities of datastore from the Logic component."}, {"sentence": 123, "text": "All GQL queries are to be contained inside the Storage component."}, {"sentence": 124, "text": "Hiding the persistable objects."}, {"sentence": 125, "text": "Classes in the storage.entity package are not visible outside this component to hide information specific to data persistence."}, {"sentence": 126, "text": "Instead, a corresponding non-persistent data transfer object named Attributes (e.g., CourseAttributes is the data transfer object for Course entities) object is returned."}, {"sentence": 134, "text": "Note that the navigability of the association links between entity objects appear to be in the reverse direction of what we see in a normal OOP design."}, {"sentence": 135, "text": "This is because we want to keep the data schema flexible so that new entity types can be added later with minimal modifications to existing elements."}, {"sentence": 136, "text": "Represented by the Db classes."}, {"sentence": 137, "text": "These classes act as the bridge to the GAE Datastore."}, {"sentence": 138, "text": "Add and Delete operations try to wait until data is persisted in the datastore before returning."}, {"sentence": 139, "text": "This is not enough to compensate for eventual consistency involving multiple servers in the GAE production environment."}, {"sentence": 140, "text": "However, it is expected to avoid test failures caused by eventual consistency in dev server and reduce such problems in the live server."}, {"sentence": 141, "text": "Eventual consistency here means it takes some time for a database operation to propagate across all serves of the Google's distributed datastore."}, {"sentence": 142, "text": "As a result, the data may be in an inconsistent states for short periods of time although things should become consistent eventually."}, {"sentence": 143, "text": "For example, an object we deleted may appear to still exist for a short while."}, {"sentence": 144, "text": "Implementation of Transaction Control has been minimized due to limitations of GAE environment and the nature of our data schema."}, {"sentence": 145, "text": "To API for creating the following information are presented."}]
